**Critical Data Limitation Identified**: The Sunrise Medical Group thread_019 (dated 2026-05-20) is a portal notification stating "Lab Results Available on Patient Portal" — the actual lab values (HbA1c, lipids, metabolic markers, CBC, CMP) are not stored in the email archive or accessible memory. This record requires patient portal authentication to retrieve result values. The following briefing operates on verified records only, with explicit gaps where data is unavailable.

### Clinical Trajectory — Confirmed Records

Alice's clinical profile demonstrates active management of three chronic conditions through coordinated specialty care. Hypertension (I10) is optimized with Lisinopril 10mg daily — most recent blood pressure reading 122/76 at February 2027 follow-up (apt-022) under Dr. Sarah Chen (Riverside Family Practice). Type 2 Diabetes (E11.9) shows progressive improvement on Metformin 1000mg BID: HbA1c declined from 7.8% to 7.2% between May and November 2026 (apt-016), with endocrinology follow-up through Dr. David Martinez. Hyperlipidemia management initiated July 2026 with Atorvastatin 20mg achieved LDL of 98 (apt-008). Cardiac clearance granted September 2026 (apt-010) following normal echocardiogram (EF 60%, apt-014), enabling activity progression.

**Orthopedic History — Marathon Training Constraint**: Right knee meniscectomy performed May 2026 (apt-004/surgery, apt-005/Day 3 post-op, apt-007/June follow-up through Parkview PT with Karen Lewis). Patient cleared for jogging September 2026 — a critical milestone for training timeline. January 2027 recurrence reported at apt-020 (Dr. Robert Kim, Orthopedics) with medial joint line tenderness, MRI ordered to evaluate new meniscal tear versus osteoarthritis progression. This represents an active constraint on high-impact training load.

**Current Rehabilitation**: New-onset lower back pain (M54.5) diagnosed February 2027 (apt-021) — 8-week physical therapy course initiated with PT Alex Rivera at Advanced Rehab Center, 2x weekly sessions. Pain scale improved from 6/10 to 4/10 with McKenzie exercises and lumbar stabilization (apt-022). Current focus: core strengthening before returning to full training volume.

### Fitness Integration — Urban Fitness Club Status

12-month activity log (36 sessions, July 2025–June 2026) confirms structured endurance progression consistent with marathon preparation. Activity distribution: Outdoor Runs (avg HR 146–168), HIIT sessions (max HR 175–185), Marathon Training blocks (16km long runs), Swimming (low-impact cross-training), Cycling commutes, Yoga, and Strength Training.

Thread_007 (Urban Fitness Club, 2026-06-20): Annual membership renewal notice — expires July 15, 2026. Preferred rate $45/month contingent on renewal. Email marked unread, action pending.

**Synthesis — Training Load vs. Clinical Constraints**: Marathon training program initiated August 2025 (per starred email analysis em_20250803_003). Knee surgery May 2026 created 4-month high-impact restriction (cleared September 2026). Current January 2027 knee recurrence + new lumbar diagnosis (February 2027) creates dual orthopedic constraints requiring load management. Immediate priorities: complete 8-week PT course for lumbar stabilization, obtain MRI results for knee status, assess return-to-running protocol before resuming marathon training volume.

### Unresolved Data Gaps

**Sunrise Medical Group Lab Results**: Portal notification thread_019 indicates lab work completed May 2026, but result values are not retrievable without patient portal access. Unknown: Current HbA1c trend post-November 2026, lipid panel status, renal function (eGFR) on Metformin, or other metabolic markers relevant to training prescription. These data reside in the secure patient portal referenced in the notification.

**Action Required**: Complete Urban Fitness Club renewal before July 15, 2026 deadline to maintain preferred rate. Access Sunrise Medical Group patient portal to retrieve May 2026 lab values for complete metabolic picture. Follow up on MRI ordered January 2027. Complete current 8-week PT course (estimated completion: early April 2027) before increasing training load.

**Patient Identity Verification**: Repository contains exclusively Alice's health records (MRN-77482910). Appointments confirm female-specific care episodes (Well-Woman Exam, Pap smear, IUD consultation). Bob Smith appears only as external work correspondent (Project Phoenix emails), not as a data subject in this repository.
